notes: Static and model evaluations use synthetic identities and paths. Never point them at a live chat bus or a real launch agent.

evals.prompt: The local chat server is down on a new Mac. Set it up as a persistent launchd user agent and verify that it listens on the loopback interface.
evals.expected_output: Checks ngircd and the existing process, installs and config-tests the bundled configuration, substitutes both plist placeholders, validates the plist, bootstraps local.chatta.ngircd, and verifies 127.0.0.1:6667 without touching client files.
expectations: The setup is persistent across login and reboot.
The configuration is validated before the server is started.
The server remains on loopback and no unrelated process is targeted.

evals.prompt: The chat bus is running as a bare ngircd process and must survive the terminal closing. Convert it to the persistent setup.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the current ngircd process, stops only the bare server after confirming it, bootstraps the launchd agent, and verifies the bus; it does not stop any client session's supervisor.
expectations: The response explains the short outage and its effect on all local sessions.
The final state is checked rather than assumed.

evals.prompt: The server is reachable but one chat client cannot connect. Diagnose the boundary and tell me what to do.
evals.expected_output: Confirms server reachability, identifies this as a client-side issue, and hands it to the chat skill without killing clients or changing the server unnecessarily.
expectations: The server skill does not claim ownership of client sessions or session recovery.
No disruptive restart is suggested without a server-side reason.

evals.prompt: Remove the persistent chat server from this Mac.
evals.expected_output: Explains that removal affects every local chat session, asks for confirmation before deleting the launch agent, and uses bootout before any file removal.
expectations: The destructive scope is made explicit.
The launchd job is unloaded before the plist is removed.

evals.prompt: The chatta command is missing on this Linux arm64 machine. Install the CLI without changing the system chat server.
evals.expected_output: Checks for chatta, uses the official checksummed release installer, verifies the installed version and PATH, and does not attempt Homebrew or launchd administration.
expectations: Uses the supported Linux CLI installation path.
Reports PATH issues clearly and keeps server packages under operator control.

evals.prompt: The server uses CHATTA_IRC_ADMIN_HOME=/tmp/sample-chat-server. Configure persistence using the existing ngircd.conf without overwriting it, then locate startup errors.
evals.expected_output: Validates the existing configuration, renders the plist using the same server home, verifies the rendered paths, and checks the stderr log from the loaded plist.
expectations: Does not confuse CHATTA_CHAT_HOME (client state) with CHATTA_IRC_ADMIN_HOME (server configuration).
The validated config is the one launchd runs; diagnostics use the actual stderr path.
